prompt_transform.guidance: State the dramatic intention before visual style so the model knows why the shot exists.
prompt_transform.template: Intent: {intent}; emotional objective: {emotion}; keep style subordinate to the beat.

negative_constraints: Do not let decorative style replace story intent.
Do not add plot events not implied by the node prompt.
quality_checks: Intent is stated in one clear sentence.
Style terms do not contradict the action or emotion.

prompt_transform.guidance: Translate abstract emotion into visible behavior, body position, gaze, gesture, or blocking.
prompt_transform.template: Action/Beat: {subject} expresses {emotion} through {action}; describe visible behavior before metaphor.

negative_constraints: Do not write only mood adjectives without observable action.
Do not ask for impossible internal thoughts without visual cues.
quality_checks: The beat contains visible movement or stillness.
The action can be staged in a single shot or node.

source_refs.label: Runway Academy Prompting Guide
source_refs.note: Prompts need visual and motion descriptions.

prompt_transform.guidance: When a node implies a scene beat, preserve editable coverage by naming establishing, medium, close, or insert intent.
prompt_transform.template: Camera/Framing: choose coverage that preserves scene geography and edit continuity for {scene}.

negative_constraints: Do not over-specify many incompatible shots in one generation node.
Do not remove scene geography when asking for close detail.
quality_checks: Coverage choice supports editing or single-shot clarity.
The shot scale matches the story beat.

source_refs.label: StudioBinder camera shots guide
source_refs.note: Shot size and movement support story, pacing, and continuity.

prompt_transform.guidance: Map emotional distance to frame distance: wide for isolation, medium for behavior, close for inner tension.
prompt_transform.template: Camera/Framing: frame {subject} at a distance that makes {emotion} readable without over-explaining.

negative_constraints: Do not use extreme close-up when the scene geography is essential.
Do not use wide framing when facial emotion is the main information.
quality_checks: Frame distance matches the emotional intent.
The prompt explains what the viewer should notice first.

source_refs.label: Adobe camera shots and angles
source_refs.note: Shot choices shape tone and emotional impact.
